name: meta-capi
title: Meta Conversions API
about: Sends a server-side Lead event to the Meta Conversions API for each form submission, as a backup for the browser pixel. Each event carries the submission id as its event id, so Meta counts a lead once when the pixel also reports it. Email, phone and name are normalised and SHA-256 hashed before they leave your site.\nEnter your Pixel ID, a Conversions API access token and your site address in the plugin's Settings tab, then grant forms, settings, web requests, database and log under Plugins, then Permissions. Choose which forms to send, map the email, phone and name fields, and optionally require a consent field. A test event code lets you check delivery in Events Manager.\nLimits: plugins never receive the visitor's IP address or browser details, so Meta matches on hashed email, phone and name only. Phone numbers need a country code. A failed delivery is logged and not retried. The delivery log keeps no field values and is cleared after 30 days.
features: Server-side Lead event for every form submission
Event id equals the submission id, so the pixel and server events are deduplicated
Email, phone and name normalised and SHA-256 hashed
Per-form selection, field mapping and an optional consent field
Send test event with your Events Manager test code
Delivery log with Meta error messages, kept 30 days, no field values
